title: My Meals
text:
I eat breakfast at home every morning. I usually have bread, eggs and a cup of tea. I eat breakfast at seven o'clock. I like my breakfast very much.

At lunch I eat at school with my friends. Lunch is soup and rice. Sometimes I eat fish too. After lunch I drink water.

questions.text: What does the writer usually have for breakfast?
options: Bread, eggs and a cup of tea

questions.text: Where does the writer eat lunch?
What can we infer about the writer's lunch?
options: The writer is not alone at lunch
The writer always eats lunch alone
The writer cooks lunch at home every day

questions.text: What can we guess about the time of the writer's breakfast?
options: It is early in the morning

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
the meal eaten in the middle of the day
people you know well and like spending time with
a hot liquid food made from water with vegetables or meat

paragraph_translations: Я снідаю вдома кожного ранку. Зазвичай я їм хліб, яйця і п'ю чашку чаю. Я снідаю о сьомій годині. Мені дуже подобається мій сніданок.
Обід я їм у школі з друзями. Обід — це суп і рис. Іноді я їм і рибу. Після обіду я п'ю воду.
